QIT M365 Governed, Technical

Governed brings identity and data under governance: risk-based sign-in and user policies, phishing-resistant authentication for all staff, an idle session timeout for sensitive clients, and Customer Lockbox. Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, sensitivity labels and DLP are set up in Entra and Purview. CIPP has no test for them, so they are not in this report.

Microsoft license: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft 365 E5

13 checks, grouped by area and ordered by risk, then by the effort to fix. Each shows this tenant's result from its latest CIPP test run.
